objective: Add a batch profile lookup endpoint POST /profiles/batch to the profiles service: up to 100 ids in, one result entry per id (null for missing), served from the existing store
in_scope: In-memory cache layer module for repeated lookups

out_of_scope.item: Migrate RequestState to contextvars (TODO in app/runtime_state.py)
out_of_scope.reason: Named non-goal: the in-repo TODO is explicitly non-blocking and belongs to a later Stage

frozen_assumptions.statement: single-process deployment; the cache layer is in-memory only
frozen_assumptions.rationale: current deployment model; no shared-state infrastructure exists in the repo

frozen_architecture.decision: the batch endpoint reads through the existing store module (app/store.py); the cache layer sits between endpoint and store
frozen_architecture.rationale: store is frozen for this Stage; cache is a new leaf module

shared_contracts.spec: POST /profiles/batch body {ids: [str]} -> 200 {results: [{id, name} | null per id]}; more than 100 ids -> 422 error.code 'too_many_ids'
shared_contracts.unfreeze_rule: Only via CONTRACT_CHANGE_REQUEST with evidence from execution

integration_seams.description: batch endpoint reads per-id results through the shared store; per-id missing returns a null entry, not an error

acceptance.description: POST /profiles/batch with 2 known and 1 unknown id returns 200 with exactly 3 results, unknown id mapped to null, and the store is queried for all ids
acceptance.positive_case: ids [p-1, p-2, p-x] are submitted and the endpoint returns 200 with 3 results
acceptance.evidence: pytest tests/test_batch_flow.py::test_batch_lookup asserts 3 results, p-x is null, and store call count
